Agent Name: WebSurfer
, Step Number: 2
, Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer made an error by misidentifying the paternal grandfather of Richard Beauchamp, 1st Earl of Worcester, as Guy de Beauchamp, 10th Earl of Warwick. The conversation consistently failed to verify this information with credible sources beyond Wikipedia, despite repeated instructions from Planner to do so. The correct paternal grandfather should have been identified as Thomas de Beauchamp, but the WebSurfer did not provide evidence or credible sources to support this, leading to the propagation of incorrect information throughout the conversation.
